recommendations.name: Jerk Chicken
recommendations.description: Chicken marinated in scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme, grilled over pimento wood.

recommendations.name: Nashville Hot Chicken
recommendations.description: Buttermilk-brined fried chicken painted with a fiery cayenne-and-fat paste, served on white bread with pickles. Heat levels go up to "extra hot."
recommendations.tip: The hot paste is traditionally made with lard or frying fat. Ask which fat they use if you avoid pork.

recommendations.name: Pad Kee Mao (Drunken Noodles)
recommendations.description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with holy basil, fresh chilies and garlic. Bold and fiery.
recommendations.tip: Normally no peanuts. Ask for "phet noi" (less spicy) if needed.

recommendations.name: Mapo Tofu
recommendations.description: Silken tofu in a fiery fermented broad-bean chili sauce with minced pork and numbing Sichuan pepper.

recommendations.name: Green Chile Enchiladas
recommendations.description: Corn tortillas layered with chicken and cheese under roasted Hatch green chile sauce. Order "Christmas" for both red and green.

recommendations.name: Tacos al Pastor
recommendations.description: Spit-roasted pork marinated in dried chilies and achiote, on corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and cilantro.

output.note: Database recommendations are a starting point; you may also suggest local dishes you know of — run check_allergens on them.
